recent_posts.title: Integrating the Particular Service Platform with Aspire
recent_posts.summary: The post provides a detailed guide on integrating the Particular Service Platform with Aspire, focusing on setting up distributed systems using containers for RabbitMQ, MongoDB, and SQL Server. Key challenges and solutions for configuring Service Control and other Particular containers are discussed, with a particular emphasis on handling dependencies and network configurations.

recent_posts.title: Upcoming Training on DDD with Vertical Slice Architecture in Munich
recent_posts.summary: A training event on Domain-Driven Design with Vertical Slice Architecture will be held in Munich on October 21-23rd. The event offers both a 2-day and 3-day version, covering larger-scale design concepts such as bounded contexts, messaging, integration patterns, and microservices. The training will also delve into refactoring systems, applying DDD techniques, and examining various design patterns. A networking event is also scheduled for the evening.

recent_posts.title: Vertical Slice Architecture Training Course in July in the Netherlands
recent_posts.summary: Vertical Slice Architecture Training Course in July in the Netherlands. Refactor existing systems, explore boundaries of cohesion, Q&A with Dutch beer.

recent_posts.title: Tales from the .NET Migration Trenches - Authentication
recent_posts.summary: This post discusses authentication in .NET migration and explores two options: remote authentication in ASP.NET 4.8 and cookie sharing between ASP.NET 4.8 and ASP.NET Core.

recent_posts.title: Upcoming Training on Modern .NET with Vertical Slice Architecture
recent_posts.summary: A two-day training course on Modern .NET systems with Vertical Slice Architecture, covering topics such as refactoring, Domain-Driven Design, design patterns, and distributed systems.

recent_posts.title: AutoMapper 13.0 Released
recent_posts.summary: Autmapper 13.0 has been released with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection support directly. The AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection package is deprecated.

recent_posts.title: Tales from the .NET Migration Trenches - Hangfire
recent_posts.summary: This post discusses the usage of Hangfire, a tool for performing background tasks in a .NET web application. It explains the configuration and usage of Hangfire in an ASP.NET 4.8 application and highlights the challenge of migrating from .NET 4.8 to .NET 6/7/8 when using Hangfire.

recent_posts.title: Tales from the .NET Migration Trenches - Our First Views
recent_posts.summary: The article discusses the challenges faced during the migration to ASP.NET Core, specifically with the migration of views and front-end assets. It explores the issues with legacy components, options for bundling and minification in ASP.NET Core, and the approach taken to handle the migration of front-end assets.

recent_posts.title: Tales from the .NET Migration Trenches - Our First Controller
recent_posts.summary: This article discusses the process of migrating a controller from .NET to ASP.NET Core. It highlights the changes that need to be made in the code and views, and also addresses the handling of feature folders in ASP.NET Core.

recent_posts.title: Tales from the .NET Migration Trenches - Shared Library
recent_posts.summary: The article discusses the process of creating a shared library for a .NET migration project. It highlights the importance of migrating common models and logic that both the .NET Framework and ASP.NET Core applications will share. The article also mentions the upgrade of dependencies and the creation of a class library that targets multiple frameworks. Finally, it emphasizes the need for careful refactoring and testing when moving types between projects.
